title: Grade 2 Math — Mon, Jun 16
description: Time — Day 1 of 5: Reading o'clock and half past
subject: mathematics

questions.question: The short hand on a clock is called the ___.
questions.explanation: The short hand is the hour hand. It points to the hour. The long hand is the minute hand.

questions.question: When the minute hand points to 12, the time is ___.
questions.explanation: When the minute hand is at 12, we say o'clock. For example: 3 o'clock, 7 o'clock.

questions.question: The hour hand is on 5 and the minute hand is on 12. What time is it?
questions.explanation: Hour hand on 5, minute hand on 12 = 5 o'clock.

questions.question: When the minute hand points to 6, we say ___.
questions.explanation: When the minute hand is at 6, we say 'half past'. Half an hour (30 minutes) has passed.

questions.question: The hour hand is between 3 and 4, and the minute hand is on 6. What time is it?
questions.explanation: Hour hand between 3 and 4, minute hand on 6 = half past 3 = 3:30.

questions.question: How many minutes are in half an hour?
questions.explanation: Half an hour = 30 minutes. One full hour = 60 minutes.

questions.question: School starts at 8 o'clock. In numbers that is ___.
questions.explanation: 8 o'clock = 8:00. When there are no extra minutes, we write :00.

questions.question: Half past 7 in numbers is ___.
questions.explanation: Half past 7 = 7:30. The minute hand is on 6 (30 minutes).

questions.question: The minute hand makes one full round in ___.
questions.explanation: The minute hand takes 60 minutes (1 hour) to go all the way around the clock.

questions.question: Half past 11 means ___.
questions.explanation: Half past 11 = 11:30. 'Half past' always means 30 minutes past the hour.

questions.question: Ravi eats lunch at half past 12. He eats at ___.
Which time shows 9 o'clock?
questions.explanation: 9 o'clock is written as 9:00 — zero extra minutes.

questions.question: A film starts at 4:30. Another way to say this is ___.
questions.explanation: 4:30 = half past 4. The minute hand is at 6.

questions.question: How many hours are in one day?
questions.explanation: There are 24 hours in one day — 12 daytime hours and 12 night-time hours.

questions.question: Priya's yoga class is 30 minutes long. She starts at 6:00. She finishes at ___.
